verdict.rationale: Docs describe Composio handling the OAuth flow end-to-end (Connect Link, callback_url, white-labeled auth pages) and explicitly state credentials are stored and refreshed per user (docs-20), but there is no documentation of encryption-at-rest/vaulting specifics, and independent security research found that a leaked Composio API key returned live Gmail/GitHub/CircleCI tokens, indicating stored credentials can be retrieved in usable form if access is compromised — undercutting the 'vaulted, encrypted' security claim. missing for 10: explicit encryption-at-rest/vaulting documentation, independent confirmation that leaked-key incident doesn't apply broadly, hands-on verification of refresh reliability.
